steps.label: Goal
steps.narration: The agent receives a user goal and must decide what information or tools are required.

steps.label: Reason
steps.narration: The model plans the next action instead of answering blindly.

steps.label: Act / tool
steps.narration: The agent calls an authorized tool or function with structured arguments.

steps.label: Observe
steps.narration: Usage, cost, latency, and traces are recorded for FinOps and incident response.

steps.label: Decide
steps.narration: The loop continues, escalates to a human, or finishes with a grounded answer.

sections.title: 12.1 Graph terminology
sections.body:
| Concept | Meaning |
|--------|--------|
| State | Shared information available during execution |
| Node | Function performing an operation |
| Edge | Transition between nodes |
| Conditional edge | Transition selected based on state |
| Reducer | Combines state updates |
| Checkpointer | Persists graph execution state |
| Store | Holds information across threads when configured |
| Thread | Persistent execution or conversation identity |
| Interrupt | Pauses execution for external input |
| Subgraph | Reusable graph within a larger workflow |
